title: Counting Words With a Given Prefix
summary: Given an array of strings named words and a string named pref, count how many strings in words start with pref.
statement: Given an array of strings named words and a string named pref, count how many strings in words start with pref.
constraints: words and pref contain lowercase English letters.
Count a word exactly when its first len(pref) characters equal pref.
A word shorter than pref does not match.
reference_solution:
def count_words_with_prefix(words,pref):
    return sum(word.startswith(pref) for word in words)
hints: This is a direct prefix predicate per word.
Use startswith so short words and mismatches are handled correctly.
Sum the boolean result of word.startswith(pref) across words.
The predicate is true exactly for the words defined by the problem, and each word contributes at most one to the count.
